GIANT SINGLE PUMPKIN — a singular massive pumpkin occupying the entire top porch step alone, its wide gentle grin the first thing the eye finds in the frame, the amber warmth from its candle reaching the hanging corncob bundles on the door and the leaf-strewn planks stretching on either side.
